in_hebrew.name: Seamus
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Seamus הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Irish Seaghsus meaning 'supplanter' or 'replacer'. This name is often associated with St. Seamus, an early Christian saint who is said to have driven out pagan gods from Ireland.

in_latin.name: Seamus
in_latin.long_meaning: Seamus est nomen liberum et insignis libertatis, quod significat liberationem et aequalitatem, cum emphasis in fraternitas et caritas.
